findings.detail: The extracted identifier is a Preferred Equity section heading, not an investment position; the actual position begins on the next row with Veronica Holdings, LLC (Vapotherm).

rationale: PP01 is a real position-purity error. In the 2024 schedule, table 23 row 2 contains only the category header 'Preferred Equity -- 5.5%' with no issuer, cost, or fair value, while row 3 contains the actual preferred equity position details. The pipeline stored the header as bdc_investment_identifier, so a non-position subtotal/category label leaked into holdings.
